workflow_rationale: This is a multi-phase feature implementation that requires creating new audio components, integrating with the existing audio engine, and adding UI controls. The feature workflow is appropriate because it involves coordinated changes across audio processing and UI layers with clear dependencies.

phases.name: Metronome Audio Core
phases.description: Create the Metronome class that generates click sounds synchronized with BPM

subtasks.description: Create Metronome class with click generation and BPM sync

verification.command: grep -q "class Metronome" Source/Audio/Metronome.h && grep -q "processBlock" Source/Audio/Metronome.cpp && echo "OK"

implementation_notes: Use std::atomic for enabled state (thread-safe)
Pre-allocate click sound buffers in prepareToPlay()
Generate simple sine wave click (e.g., 1kHz, 10ms duration)
Accent click should be louder (1.5x amplitude) for first beat
Calculate beat timing from playhead position and BPM
NO memory allocation in processBlock() - audio thread constraint
Support 4/4 time signature (4 beats per measure)
subtasks.notes: Created Metronome class with thread-safe audio processing. Implemented pre-allocated click buffers (1kHz sine wave, 10ms duration), accent on first beat (1.5x louder), BPM synchronization, and no memory allocation in processBlock(). Verification passed successfully.

subtasks.description: Add Metronome member to AudioEngine and integrate in audio callback

verification.command: grep -q "Metronome metronome;" Source/Audio/AudioEngine.h && grep -q "metronome.processBlock" Source/Audio/AudioEngine.cpp && echo "OK"

implementation_notes: Add Metronome member variable to AudioEngine class
Add getMetronome() accessor method
Call metronome.prepareToPlay() in AudioEngine::prepareToPlay()
Call metronome.processBlock() in AudioEngine::getNextAudioBlock()
Mix metronome output AFTER timeline/mixer processing
Metronome should receive playhead position and BPM from Transport
Create separate buffer for metronome, then mix into main output
subtasks.notes: Added Metronome member to AudioEngine class with getMetronome() accessor methods. Integrated metronome.prepareToPlay() in AudioEngine::prepareToPlay() and metronome.processBlock() in AudioEngine::getNextAudioBlock() after mixer processing. Metronome receives playhead position, BPM, and playing state from Transport. Verification passed successfully.

subtasks.notes: Added Metronome.h and Metronome.cpp to CMakeLists.txt in the Audio section alongside other audio components (AudioEngine, AudioTrack, etc.). Verification passed successfully.

Added onMetronomeToggle callback to call audioEngine.getMetronome().setEnabled(bool) and onMetronomeVolumeChange callback to call audioEngine.getMetronome().setVolume(double) in setupTransportCallbacks() method. Follows existing callback patterns for play, stop, and record controls.

phases.name: Count-in Feature
phases.description: Add count-in functionality for recording preparation

subtasks.description: Add count-in state and logic to Metronome class
implementation_notes: Add std::atomic<int> countInBars (0, 1, or 2)
Add std::atomic<bool> isCountingIn state
Add std::atomic<int64_t> countInStartPosition
Add methods: setCountInBars(int), startCountIn(int64_t pos), isInCountIn()
Modify processBlock to handle count-in phase
Count-in should play clicks but not start actual recording
After count-in bars elapsed, signal completion
subtasks.notes: Added count-in state and logic to Metronome class. Implemented setCountInBars(), startCountIn(), isInCountIn(), and isCountInComplete() methods. Added atomic state variables for countInBars (0-2), isCountingIn, and countInStartPosition. Modified processBlock() to handle count-in phase - metronome plays clicks during count-in even when not explicitly enabled. Verification passed successfully.

verification.instructions: Build and run application, open settings panel, verify count-in combo box appears

implementation_notes: Add ComboBox countInComboBox with options: 'Off', '1 bar', '2 bars'
Add Label countInLabel with text 'Count-in:'
Add callback std::function<void(int)> onCountInChange
Update resized() to position controls
Default to '1 bar' count-in
subtasks.notes: Created SettingsPanel UI component with count-in ComboBox ('Off', '1 bar', '2 bars'), default set to '1 bar', count-in label, callback for count-in changes, and getCountInBars() method. Follows TransportBar patterns with proper JUCE component lifecycle management. Files created: Source/UI/SettingsPanel.h and Source/UI/SettingsPanel.cpp.

subtasks.description: Integrate count-in with recording start in MainComponent

verification.instructions: Enable count-in, press record, verify metronome plays count-in bars before recording starts

implementation_notes: When record button pressed and count-in enabled, start count-in first
Call audioEngine.getMetronome().startCountIn(currentPosition)
Delay actual recording start until count-in complete
Use Timer or callback to check when count-in finished
Then call audioEngine.startRecording()
subtasks.notes: Integrated count-in with recording start in MainComponent. Created CountInTimer helper class for polling count-in completion. Modified onRecord callback and keyboard command handler to check count-in setting before recording. When enabled, starts count-in, plays metronome, and waits for completion before starting actual recording. When disabled, starts recording immediately. Timer auto-deletes after count-in completes.

phases.name: Visual Beat Indicator
phases.description: Add visual beat indicator synced with metronome

subtasks.description: Add beat indicator component to StatusBar or TransportBar

verification.instructions: Build and run application, start playback with metronome enabled, verify beat indicator flashes on each beat

implementation_notes: Add small LED-style indicator that lights up on each beat
Use Transport playhead position and BPM to calculate current beat
Indicator should flash briefly (50-100ms) on each beat
Accent beat (first of measure) should be different color or brighter
Use Timer callback to update indicator state
Should work even when metronome sound is disabled (visual only option)
subtasks.notes: Created StatusBar component with visual beat indicator LED. Implemented 75ms flash duration on each beat, with brighter green (lime) for accent beats (first of measure) and dimmer green for normal beats. Uses juce::Timer with 16ms interval (60 FPS) for smooth animation. Calculates beat position from Transport playhead and BPM. Works independently of metronome sound state. Wired StatusBar to receive Transport reference in MainComponent. Follows JUCE component patterns from TransportBar.

subtasks.notes: Added export mode functionality to Metronome class with setExportMode(bool) method and thread-safe atomic flag. Modified processBlock() to skip processing when exportMode is true. Created comprehensive documentation (EXPORT_GUIDELINES.md and METRONOME_EXPORT_VERIFICATION.md) for future AudioExporter implementation. Recording already excludes metronome correctly by design. Verification passed successfully.
